title: RNA Binding Mechanism of the FUS Zinc Finger in Concert with Its Flanking Intrinsically Disordered Region.
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD和dPCSMD模拟，揭示FUS ZnF及其侧翼IDR(RGG2)协同结合RNA的机制：结构化ZnF特异性识别GGU序列，IDR非特异结合并扭曲RNA骨架增强亲和力，并推广到DisProt数据库验证IDR辅助核酸结合为普遍机制，高度契合无序蛋白介导PPI/核酸互作的机制建模主题。
abstract: The zinc finger (ZnF) motif is one of the most common nucleic acid binding motifs in proteins and comprises approximately 5% of the human genome. Proteins often carry multiple copies of ZnF motifs, enhancing DNA- and RNA-binding affinity and specificity. Fused in Sarcoma (FUS) is an RNA-binding protein that contains one ZnF motif and one RNA recognition motif. We identified the molecular basis for the strong and specific binding of FUS ZnF to RNA at atomic resolution by performing molecular dynamics and dissociation parallel cascade selection molecular dynamics simulations of a single-stranded RNA complexed with FUS ZnF and the flanking RGG2 domain. The RGG2-ZnF construct was classified into two regions based on atomic fluctuation: an intrinsically disordered region (IDR) consisting mainly of RGG2 and a structured region consisting mainly of the ZnF motif. Our results on intermolecular interactions, dissociation process, binding affinity, and free energy landscape indicate that the structured region specifically recognizes the GGU sequence of RNA, while the IDR interacts nonspecifically with the RNA backbone and distorts it. Although the binding of the structured region alone with the short RNA sequence is relatively weak, the binding of the IDR exhibits a 2-fold lower dissociation constant due to the addition of nonspecific charge interactions with RNA backbone phosphate groups. Further comprehensive analysis of nucleic acid binding motifs in the DisProt database suggests that the stabilization of protein-RNA binding by only one or a few nucleic acid binding motifs with flanking disordered regions, as in the case of FUS, ZnF is a common mechanism for ensuring strong and specific nucleic acid binding in nucleic acid binding proteins, as is the involvement of more nucleic acid binding motifs. Our findings allow us to expand the repertoire of disordered region-assisted nucleic acid binding by ZnF from double-stranded DNAs to single-stranded RNAs.
abstract_zh: 锌指（ZnF）基序是蛋白质中最常见的核酸结合基序之一，约占人类基因组的5%。蛋白质通常携带多个ZnF基序拷贝，从而增强DNA和RNA的结合亲和力及特异性。融合肉瘤（FUS）是一种RNA结合蛋白，含有一个ZnF基序和一个RNA识别基序。我们通过分子动力学（molecular dynamics）和离解并行级联选择分子动力学（dissociation parallel cascade selection molecular dynamics）模拟，对与FUS ZnF及侧翼RGG2结构域复合的单链RNA进行了原子分辨率研究，确定了FUS ZnF与RNA强特异性结合的分子基础。基于原子波动，RGG2-ZnF构建体被分为两个区域：主要由RGG2组成的固有无序区域（intrinsically disordered region, IDR）和主要由ZnF基序组成的有序区域。我们对分子间相互作用、离解过程、结合亲和力及自由能景观的结果表明，有序区域特异性识别RNA的GGU序列，而IDR则与RNA骨架非特异性相互作用并使其扭曲。尽管有序区域单独与短RNA序列的结合相对较弱，但IDR的结合因与RNA骨架磷酸基团增加非特异性电荷相互作用而表现出2倍更低的解离常数。对DisProt数据库中核酸结合基序的进一步综合分析表明，如FUS ZnF案例所示，仅一个或少数核酸结合基序与侧翼无序区域共同稳定蛋白质-RNA结合，是确保核酸结合蛋白中强特异性核酸结合的常见机制，与涉及更多核酸结合基序的情况类似。我们的发现扩展了ZnF通过无序区域辅助核酸结合的范围，从双链DNA扩展至单链RNA。
